dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A cluster of 4-5 small, sharp-edged O-shaped rings on the anterior-lateral surface with high-contrast light perimeters surrounding dark centers. Mid-body features a large, irregular C-shaped boundary with a feathered gradient transitioning from a bright exterior edge to a medium-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low overall density of solid clusters, featuring one prominent, high-intensity white triangular blob on the posterolateral margin and several isolated, single-pixel high-intensity specks scattered across the upper dorsal dark-pixel field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest anterior-lateral annuli form an approximate isosceles triangle. A long linear axis can be drawn connecting the centroid of the mid-body C-shape to the centroid of the posterior triangular blob.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive interconnected reticulated network of light curvilinear markings forming a web-like pattern across the mid-lateral to ventral-lateral transition.
